channel.title: National Oil And Lube News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from National Oil And Lube News (noln.net)

item.title: Feature Read: Dollars in the Details
item.description: Small inefficiencies left unchecked can result in big expenditures for quick lube operators, says Victory Lane Executive VP Jim Harrington.

item.title: One Size Doesn't Always Fit All
item.description: Quick lube brands must navigate local requirements and adjust facility plans accordingly when constructing new shops.

item.title: From Marine to Market Manager
item.description: A three-time winner of Jiffy Lube's President's Performance Excellence Award, Marine Corp veteran Eric Hartlen has become a store manager that turns locations into nationwide top performers.

item.title: Podcast | Acquisitions, Honors, and Marketing Matters: Catching Up on NOLN Headlines
item.description: Quick lube companies are making headlines with acquisitions, marketing news, and appearances in national franchise rankings.

item.title: Tremper: Retention in the Age of Automation: Why Smarter Reminders Win Repeat Business
item.description: While retention has always mattered for automotive service shops, customers now expect to be reminded to return, driven in large part by automation and better use of service data.

item.title: Outside Hires Bring Potential New Insights
item.description: Quick lube operators can get fresh perspectives by hiring candidates whose work experience comes from outside the quick lube industry to key leadership roles.

item.title: Preventative Automotive Maintenance Association Partners With AAPEX to Host iFlex
item.description: The 2026 AAPEX will feature the International Fast Lube Expo, branded as iFlex @ AAPEX, offering quick lube operators expanded industry visibility, training, and networking opportunities within the automotive aftermarket ecosystem.

item.title: Podcast | Feature Read: Evolving Oils, Evolving Challenges
item.description: Representatives for national distributors who serve the automotive industry say new motor oil formulations offer improved efficiency and longer drain intervals, but come with potential pitfalls.

item.title: Golden and Yu: Quick Lube: Why M&A has Driven Quick Lube Industry Growth
item.description: Several factors have led to acquisitions becoming the primary growth driver for major players.

item.title: Right to Repair Legislation: Support Grows, Battle Continues
item.description: As the REPAIR Act gains momentum in Congress, the Auto Care Association seeks backing in its effort to make automotive repair data accessible to independent shops.
